solution_architecture: Power BI writeback using UDF and on-premises data gateway

artifacts.name: HRData
artifacts.description: Fabric SQL Database storing employee records and NeedsWriteback staging table
artifacts.deployment_notes: Deploy first. Run scripts/01-table-creation.sql to create schema.

artifacts.name: HRData
artifacts.description: SQL endpoint for querying HRData database (automatically created)
artifacts.deployment_notes: Automatically created with SQL Database. Use as data source for Semantic Model.

artifacts.name: EmployeeWritebackFunctions
artifacts.description: RESTful API endpoint that receives writeback requests from Power BI, writes to NeedsWriteback, and triggers sync pipeline
artifacts.deployment_notes: Deploy UDF code, configure workspace/database/pipeline IDs, test with sample POST request.

artifacts.name: Pipeline_IngestEmployees
artifacts.description: Initial data ingestion from on-premises SQL Server to Fabric SQL Database
artifacts.deployment_notes: Configure on-premises data gateway connection to source SQL Server. Copy data from on-prem Employees table to HRData.Employees.

artifacts.name: Pipeline_Writeback_to_On-Prem
artifacts.description: Syncs writeback changes from NeedsWriteback staging table to on-premises SQL Server via gateway
artifacts.deployment_notes: Requires on-premises data gateway. Deploy stored procedure (scripts/usp-update-employee-with-pipeline-trigger.sql) to on-prem SQL Server. Configure pipeline to call stored procedure via gateway.

artifacts.name: Semantic Model
artifacts.description: Data model connecting to HRData SQL endpoint for Power BI reporting
artifacts.deployment_notes: Create semantic model from HRData SQL endpoint. Import Employees table. Configure measures and relationships.

artifacts.name: Employee Records Dashboard
artifacts.description: Interactive Power BI report with writeback buttons that trigger UDF
artifacts.writeback_method: Button actions POST to EmployeeWritebackFunctions UDF endpoint
artifacts.deployment_notes: Create report from Semantic Model. Add button visuals configured to POST to UDF endpoint with employee data.

deployment_order: 1. HRData (SQL Database) - Run table creation script
2. On-Premises Data Gateway - Install and configure
4. Pipeline_IngestEmployees - Initial data load from on-prem
5. Pipeline_Writeback_to_On-Prem - Deploy on-prem stored procedure and pipeline
6. Semantic Model - Connect to HRData SQL endpoint
7. Employee Records Dashboard - Configure writeback buttons to call UDF
data_flow: 2. HRData.Employees → SQL Endpoint → Semantic Model → Employee Records Dashboard
3. User Edit in Dashboard → Button POST → EmployeeWritebackFunctions UDF
external_dependencies: On-premises data gateway (required for both pipelines)
On-premises SQL Server (source and writeback destination)
Stored procedure: usp_UpdateEmployee (on on-prem SQL Server)
excluded_technologies: Power Automate (not used in this solution)
